sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (₹1L–₹5L based on medical test grid)

room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day or actuals whichever is less; ICU at 2% of SI/day; overall room/ICU limit 25% of SI per illness

icu.note: ICU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day or actuals whichever is less; subject to overall 25% of SI per illness cap

copayment.note: 10% co-pay on all hospitalisation claims; 20% on pre-existing disease claims (including portability cases); 15% on day care procedures; no co-pay on packaged hospital charges

sub_limits.note: Cataract per eye ₹10,000; other eye surgery ₹15,000; tumour/cysts ₹20,000; urinary stones ₹20,000; hernia ₹20,000; appendicectomy ₹20,000; knee ligament ₹40,000; hysterectomy ₹20,000; fissures/piles/fistula ₹15,000; spine ₹40,000; cellulitis/abscess ₹15,000; surgeon fees capped at 25% SI; room/ICU at 25% SI per illness

initial_waiting.note: First 30 days waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 36 months of continuous coverage; credits from prior insurer portable

specific_disease_waiting.note: List includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, arthritis, spinal disorders, stones, hysterectomy, skin tumours, dialysis, varicose veins, joint replacements, and others

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Option A: 5% increase in SI per claim-free year up to 50% max; reduced at same rate if claim made. Option B: premium discount instead (up to 10 years). Insured chooses one option.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

day_care.note: Day care procedures covered as per annexed list; not all day-care procedures

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered up to 50% of Sum Insured or actuals whichever is less

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered under hospitalisation benefit; must be in recognised AYUSH hospital meeting specified criteria

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation expenses of organ donor during transplant covered subject to sub-limits under head C

ambulance.note: Reimbursement for road ambulance to nearest hospital; capped at 1% of SI or ₹1,500 or actuals whichever is less

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic treatments as a covered or excluded benefit

consumables.note: Annexure A lists most consumables as not payable; disposable surgical consumables under head C capped at 7% of SI

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states benefits payable only for treatment in India

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; includes portability/migration credits

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium; 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for policies of 1 year or more

portability.note: Portability of waiting period credits and NCB to another insurer permitted as per IRDAI norms

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, dental (OPD), refractive error <7.5D, obesity surgery, cosmetic surgery, addiction treatment, external durable devices, OPD treatment

optional_riders.display: Section B Critical Illness cover (optional); Floater extension for spouse; Long-term policy (2/3 yr discount)
